Title: Enkil Cog and Mask of a thousand faces

Messages.Author: Oshi
Messages.Body:
I suspect the answer is going to be "No" but it's worth getting it in black and white.

Can a out-of-turn Enkil cog action be modified by Mask of a thousand faces?

Is being able act during the current turn part of being "capable of performing the action"

Messages.Author: Legion
Messages.Body: I think the card's text is pretty clear. If you have a ready, unlocked vampire who is other than the acting minion and who is capable of performing the action. the answer would be yes. In all other cases the answer is NOT.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
> Legion wrote:
> I think the card's text is pretty clear. If you have a ready, unlocked vampire who is other than the acting minion and who is capable of performing the action. the answer would be yes. In all other cases the answer is NOT.
>
Correct, Enkil Cog provides an effects that could not have been used if the masking vampire were the acting vampire.

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body: Folloup question, for more edgcecases: If there is a "Malkavian Madness network" in play, could a Malkavian (of the same controller) take over the action with mask of a thousand faces, of a minion acting via enkil cog?

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
Good question. These standing rulings make it tricky:
>
> Cannot be used to mask an action if the masking vampire is not capable of taking that action, nor if any effect (modifier, reaction, {Aching Beauty}, inherent stealth), has been played on this action that could not have been played if the masking minion were the acting minion (not counting blood spent).  [RTR 19980623]  [RTR 20030519]  [LSJ 20030520]  [RTR 20041202]
>
I would say that locking Enkil Cog to be able to act is not "an effect played on this action that could not have been played if the masking vampire was acting", because it's locked before the action, and answer this with a yes, the Malkavian can take over. But this is, I think debatable - you could say Enkil Cog is an effect played on the action (and not transferable, since you need to be the vampire with Enkil Cog to use its effect), so no masking.

Messages.Author: Oshi
Messages.Body:
If you wanted to be pedantic you could argue that no vampires are capable of performing an action while another vamp is acting. "able to currently act" as a condition would render mask non functional.
Im just saying that theres room for interpretation on what being "capable" means.

but the implication would be: madness network spreads to anyone with obf. for the health of the game perhaps rule against that.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Possible scenarios (i think it cover all);

Enkil Cog (only on the acting vampire) action + Mask of a Thousand Faces
Cannot be masked because;  Enkil Cog only provides the ability to act on another Methuselah's minion phase to the vampire it is on by card text "this vampire can lock this card to take an action". Mask of a Thousand Faces isn´t playable as the effect of Enkil Cog doesn't carry over to the masking vampire who fails the condition "Only usable by a ... vampire ... who is capable of performing the action.".   Enkil Cog (both vampires having one) action + Mask of a Thousand Faces
Cannot be masked because;  Same reasons as for nr 1 Enkil Cog cannot be used during another action as it declares an action.  ** overlooked Enkil Cog is unique. Enkil Cog (only on the acting non-Malkavian vampire) action + Mask of a Thousand Faces (by a Malkavian while Madness Network is in play)
Cannot be masked because;  Enkil Cog only provides its effect to the vampire it is on by card text "this vampire can ...". Mask of a Thousand Faces isn´t playable as the effect of Enkil Cog doesn't carry over to the masking vampire who fails the condition "Not usable if any ... effects have been used that could not have been used if this vampire were the acting vampire.". Even though Enkil Cog and Madness Network provide a similar ability to act during other Methuselah´s minion phase they are NOT the same effect in regards to the condition of Mask of a Thousand Faces.   Madness Network (only acting is Malkavian) action + Mask of a Thousand Faces
Cannot be masked because;  Madness Network while in play only grant Malkavians the ability to act during other Methuselahs minion phase by card text "Malkavians can take actions in any Methuselah's minion phase". Mask of a Thousand Faces isn´t playable as the effect of Madness Network doesn't carry over to the masking vampire who fails the condition "Only usable by a ... vampire ... who is capable of performing the action.   Madness Network (only acting is Malkavian) action + Mask of a Thousand Faces (by a vampire with Enkil Cog)
Cannot be masked because;  Same reasons as for nr 4. Enkil Cog cannot be used during another action as it declares an action.   Madness Network (both being Malkavian) action + Mask of a Thousand Faces
Can be masked because;  Madness Network while in play provides all Malkavians the inherent ability to be allowed to act during other Methuselah´s minion phases. The conditions of Mask of a Thousand Faces can be fully met.

Enkil Cog

Cardtype: Action Modifier
Unique. Requires a vampire with capacity 10 or more. Only usable after resolution of a successful bleed against your prey.
Put this card on this vampire. This vampire gets +1 bleed. During any Methuselah's minion phase, this vampire can lock this card to take an action.

Madness Network

Cardtype: Master
Clan: Malkavian
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Unlocked Malkavians can take actions in any Methuselah's minion phase (follow normal sequencing rules). Any minion can burn this card as an action that any unlocked Malkavian (in addition to the normally eligible blockers) can attempt to block.

Mask of a Thousand Faces

Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Obfuscate
Only usable by a ready, unlocked vampire other than the acting minion who is capable of performing the action. Not usable if any action modifiers or other effects have been used that could not have been used if this vampire were the acting vampire. Unlock the acting minion and lock this vampire instead. The action continues with this vampire as the acting minion.
As above, with +1 stealth.

Messages.Body:

> If you wanted to be pedantic you could argue that no vampires are capable of performing an action while another vamp is acting. "able to currently act" as a condition would render mask non functional.
> .

The text "Only usable by a ready, unlocked vampire other than the acting minion who is capable of performing the action." only refers to the ability to be able to perform the action it would modify and doesn´t make any reference about acting during another action which is enabled by the nature of that the card is an action modifier... that would lead not to taking a new action during another action but to take over the modified action.
